content.text:
Catalog search now ignores accents in both the query and the stored titles and authors, so `garcia marquez` finds García Márquez. All 61 tests pass, including a new one for accented search.

The fix is in `normaliseText` in `lib/helpers/text.js`. It now decomposes each character into a base letter plus accent marks and drops the marks before lower-casing. That happens before the punctuation-collapsing step, because that step would otherwise treat a leftover accent mark as punctuation and split the word. `normaliseText` is only used by catalog search, so nothing else changes.

The new test in `test/catalog.test.js` adds an item titled *Cien años de soledad* by García Márquez, Gabriel. It checks that `garcia marquez`, `GARCÍA MÁRQUEZ` and `anos soledad` all find it.

I haven't committed anything.
